guide_basis: E2 sections 11 and 14: preserve scientific model and equal search opportunities; profile actual cost. No new published-body exemption.
wave_order: all fixed-body/reference models across three origins, then all NAS models across three origins
profile_rule: Five timed synthetic forward-backward repeats for each of five widths and batches16/32/64, with six kernels. Dispatch cropped computation only for measured width/batch cases with >=1.05 median speedup and passing output/gradient parity. Kernel counts2/4 and unprofiled batches retain exact legacy dispatch. No market score used.
cost_limit: transfer only unspent original registered 48-hour wall budget; no automatic extension or reset
reuse_rule: immutable verified ancestor snapshot at or after R4 completion; exact original job, seed, split and payload binding; reused outcomes are never counted as new optimizer work
numerical_scope: mathematical equality, bounded floating-point differences; not bitwise training-trajectory equality. Preserve implementation provenance; final refits must use a common declared implementation.
accounting_note: Successful admission, resource profiling and cached replay are charged through an anchored session clock. Rejected preflight may consume external resources without a scientific campaign record. Final publication tail follows the frozen ledger boundary.
